introduction: Montana weatherization helps eligible households improve energy efficiency. The program uses a combined LIHEAP and Weatherization application.
description: Montana weatherization helps eligible households improve energy efficiency. The program uses a combined LIHEAP and Weatherization application.

sections.who: LIHEAP-qualified households also qualify for weatherization screening. Need-based priority includes older and disabled household members.
sections.get: An auditor selects cost-effective measures. Funding limits can prevent every requested improvement.
sections.docs:
• Income and household records.
  • Energy bills.
  • Property or landlord information requested locally.
sections.apply:
1. Contact intake

    Use DPHHS weatherization guidance and the local or Tribal office.

  2. Submit the combined form

    Weatherization applications are available year-round.

  3. Arrange the audit

    The auditor assesses the home and suitable measures.
sections.after: If approved without priority and not served within a year, the state advises reapplying.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Montana weatherization process. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
